newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs dlr, steady vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended lower on Monday as the dollar/mark rallied after weekend losses, dealers said.
However, the Hungarian unit was unmoved against the currency basket as it ended at 180.25/30 to one dollar after opening at 179.60/65.
Dealers said trade was light with the forint sticking close to the resistance level of the central bank's intervention band.
(NBH floating intervention range: 4.5 percent wide. NBH currency basket: 30 percent dollar + 70 percent mark.)
